---
name: Evidence proposal
about: Suggest an original source or correct a specific finding or annotation.
title: ""
---

## Entity or finding

Name the gene/protein/pathway, existing claim ID if known, and the research question or correction this addresses.

## Original source

Provide the DOI/PMID or database URL and the exact inspected figure, table, section or record version. Link to the source rather than copying an article or figure.

## What was tested or annotated?

Describe the species/model, gene versus protein or variant, assay/readout and result. Record replicate units, controls, unknowns and limitations where available. Distinguish a database annotation from an original experimental finding.

## Access and provenance

Record the inspection date, what you could actually access, and known reuse/publication status. Leave unknowns explicit. A proposal starts a source check; it does not automatically create graph claims or review approvals.
